verdict.rationale: Operating a tax-filing portal through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a guided step-by-step web interface, document uploads and photo capture, automatic return preparation in the MeinELSTER+ app, and third-party software transmission. None of it documents a natural-language command, chat or assistant interface, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
